CorpFlowAI commercial terms

  2. Scope. Scope is limited to the products and services described in this quotation. Additional or changed work will be agreed separately before it is undertaken.

  6. No outcome guarantees. CorpFlowAI does not guarantee search rankings, enquiry volumes, conversions, sales or revenue.
  7. Release and delivery. Production release or final delivery is subject to the agreed review, approval and payment conditions applicable to the quoted work.
  8. Commercial contact. Commercial enquiries: finance@corpflowai.com.
